name: Cen.Grand
_terms_read_and_they_do_not_forbid_it: en.cen-grand.com and www.cen-grand.com (Shenzhen Cen.grand Digital Media Technology Co., Ltd., 深圳市世纪格雷数字媒体科技有限公司) read 2026-11-27 with curl. robots.txt on both hosts: « User-agent: * », disallowing only « /?p=* », « /?s=* » and « /?r=* » - no Content-Signal and no group naming any AI agent. NO terms, legal-notice or copyright page exists: the English sitemap's 127 URLs list none, the footer links only About, Products, Support, Network and Contact, and the about, intro, download and companyfile pages were swept for reproduc, copyright, permission, prohibit, reprint, terms and intellectual, the Chinese pages for 转载, 禁止, 未经, 版权 and 授权. The only hit is the footer: « Copyright © 2022 CEN.GRAND All Rights Reserved. » A footer, not a prohibition, so the standing rule integrates. The catalogue stores no images and no logos.
_cengrand_com_is_not_dead_it_redirects: The brief this batch started from said cengrand.com does not resolve. Over HTTPS it does not answer; over plain HTTP, www.cengrand.com answers 200 after a redirect to https://www.cen-grand.com/ - the hyphenated domain is the maker's current one, and it links its English site at en.cen-grand.com. Worth recording so the next reader does not conclude the brand has no publication.
_the_maker_names_its_own_distributors: The English site's « Network » section lists dealers by country, Audiophonics (France) among them (en.cen-grand.com/product/157.html). Nothing in these records comes from any dealer: every figure is from the maker's own product pages.
_models_read_and_not_recorded: GLD 1.0 Standard and Deluxe (product/169, 168) are digital players that output to a DAC (POW, S/PDIF, HDMI-I2S) and convert nothing; 9i-92DE is titled « Media Player （Digital Output via USB Only) »; 9i-906 and 9i-806 are headphone amplifiers; 9i-938/958 and the 9i-808/810/908 are amplifiers. The past products 9i-60 DAC (product/64) and 9i-80S (www.cen-grand.com/product/54.html) carry no specification text at all - the 9i-60 page reads « We could not find any corresponding parameters » - and the 9i-80S's only text is a Chinese category blurb naming an AK4495 and an XMOS USB interface with no rate, too thin to be worth a record.
